prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Square intimate fashion photograph of a cream Devon Rex kitten with enormous ears and pale green eyes, nestling in an oversized sky-blue cotton bow against a soft coral backdrop. Irresistible curious expression, delicate short curly fur, diffused daylight. Intended final composition 1200:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
